P.name: The Hitman and the Seer
P.summary: Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Basic Attack and Ability. Attacks and abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next of the 5.
P.bodyHtml:
Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister, Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Attack and Ability [?]. Attacks and Abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next one.

Aphelios unlocks his weapon's Ability [?] at level 2 and his Ultimate at level 6. Instead of powering up his Abilities, Aphelios' rank-ups grant him permanent stats.

Q.name: Weapon Abilites
Q.summary:
Aphelios has 5 different activated abilities, based on his main-hand weapon:

Calibrum (Rifle): Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack.
Severum (Scythe Pistol): Run fast while attacking nearby enemies with both weapons.
Gravitum (Cannon): Root all enemies slowed by this weapon.
Infernum (Flamethrower): Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your off-hand weapon.
Crescendum (Chakram): Deploy a sentry that shoots your off-hand weapon.
Q.bodyHtml:
Calibrum Active: Aphelios fires a long range shot, dealing (160 + (60% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) physical damage to the first enemy hit and marking them.

Severum Active: Aphelios gains (25% + (0.1% Ability Power)) Move Speed and fires both weapons at the nearest enemy for the next 1.75 seconds. Deals (6 + (200.004% bonus Attack Speed)) × (40% Attack Damage) physical damage over (6 + (200.004% bonus Attack Speed)) shots, prioritizing champions.

Infernum Active: Aphelios spouts a wave of flame, dealing (110 + (21% bonus Attack Damage) + (70% Ability Power)) physical damage. Then he Attacks each enemy hit with his off-hand weapon.

Crescendum Active: Aphelios deploys a lunar sentry equipped with Aphelios' off-hand weapon that lasts 20 seconds. Sentries activate when an enemy approaches and fire at them for (125 + (52% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage per shot over 4 seconds.

Gravitum Active: Aphelios triggers a gravity field on enemies he has Slowed with Gravitum, Rooting for 1 second and dealing (140 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

E.summary: Aphelios has no third ability. This slot shows the next weapon Alune will give him. Weapon order begins fixed but may change over game time -- when a weapon is out of ammo it goes to the end of the order.

Attacks and Abilities using this weapon restore Health and can overheal you.

R.name: Moonlight Vigil
R.summary: Fire a concentrated blast of moonlight that explodes on enemy champions. Applies the unique effect of Aphelios' main-hand gun.
R.bodyHtml:
Aphelios fires a concentrated blast of moonlight that explodes when it hits a champion, dealing (125/175/225 + (20% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) physical damage to surrounding enemies.

Then, Aphelios attacks all champions hit with his main-hand weapon.

Calibrum Bonus: Marks added this way deal an additional 50/80/110 physical damage each when consumed.



Severum Bonus: Aphelios restores 250/350/450 Health.



Infernum Bonus: The moonlight blast deals an additional (50/100/150 + (25% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, and the subsequent Attacks explode, each dealing 90% of their damage to surrounding targets.



Crescendum Bonus: Summons an additional 5 mirror Chakram.



Gravitum Bonus: Slow strength increased to 99%. Binding Eclipse's Root effect is increased to 1.35 seconds against these targets.

The Attacks apply on-hits. Critical strikes deal 100% of normal damage instead.
